import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, re, datetime, ssl
from html import unescape

TZ = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=7))
def now_rfc3339():
    return datetime.datetime.now(TZ).isoformat(timespec="seconds")

DOIS = [
    ("S19", "10.1109/ICWS72778.2026.00154"),
    ("S20", "10.1109/ICWS72778.2026.00067"),
    ("C03", "10.23939/ictee2026.02.144"),
    ("C05", "10.1109/TCSVT.2026.3745821"),
    ("C09", "10.1109/JIOT.2026.3755315"),
    ("C10", "10.1109/JIOT.2026.3740035"),
    ("C13", "10.1109/TVT.2026.3755123"),
    ("C14", "10.1109/JIOT.2026.3746980"),
    ("C19", "10.1109/JIOT.2026.3755176"),
    ("C08_candidate", "10.1016/j.future.2025.107874"),
]

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "HK261-PRISMA-IdentityCheck/1.0 (mailto:research@example.edu)",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/json;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
}

def fetch(url, accept=None, timeout=15):
    ts = now_rfc3339()
    h = dict(HEADERS)
    if accept:
        h["Accept"] = accept
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
            return {
                "url": url,
                "final_url": resp.geturl(),
                "accessed_at": ts,
                "status": resp.status,
                "content_type": resp.headers.get("Content-Type"),
                "body": raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                "error": None,
            }
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = b""
        try:
            raw = e.read()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {
            "url": url,
            "final_url": e.geturl() if hasattr(e, "geturl") else url,
            "accessed_at": ts,
            "status": e.code,
            "content_type": e.headers.get("Content-Type") if e.headers else None,
            "body": raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:4000],
            "error": f"HTTPError {e.code}: {e.reason}",
        }
    except Exception as e:
        return {
            "url": url,
            "final_url": None,
            "accessed_at": ts,
            "status": None,
            "content_type": None,
            "body": "",
            "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}",
        }

out = {"crossref": {}, "doi_publisher": {}, "arxiv": {}}

for rid, doi in DOIS:
    cr_url = f"https://api.crossref.org/works/{doi}"
    res = fetch(cr_url, accept="application/json")
    entry = {
        "url": cr_url,
        "accessed_at": res["accessed_at"],
        "status": res["status"],
        "error": res["error"],
    }
    if res["status"] == 200:
        data = json.loads(res["body"]).get("message", {})
        keys = [
            "DOI", "type", "title", "subtitle", "container-title", "short-container-title",
            "publisher", "volume", "issue", "page", "article-number",
            "published", "published-online", "published-print", "issued",
            "created", "deposited", "indexed", "accepted", "posted",
            "event", "URL", "is-referenced-by-count", "alternative-id", "relation",
            "assertion", "update-to", "content-domain"
        ]
        meta = {k: data.get(k) for k in keys if k in data}
        if "author" in data:
            meta["author"] = [
                {k: a.get(k) for k in ("given", "family", "sequence", "ORCID") if k in a}
                for a in data["author"]
            ]
        entry["metadata"] = meta
    out["crossref"][rid] = entry

    doi_url = f"https://doi.org/{doi}"
    pub_res = fetch(doi_url)
    p_entry = {
        "url": doi_url,
        "final_url": pub_res["final_url"],
        "accessed_at": pub_res["accessed_at"],
        "status": pub_res["status"],
        "error": pub_res["error"],
        "content_type": pub_res["content_type"],
    }
    if pub_res["body"]:
        html = pub_res["body"]
        # Extract <title> and meta tags and IEEE xplore global.document.metadata if present
        title_m = re.search(r"<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>", html, re.S | re.I)
        p_entry["html_title"] = unescape(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", title_m.group(1)).strip()) if title_m else None
        metas = {}
        for m in re.finditer(r"<meta\s+([^>]+)>", html, re.I):
            attrs = dict(re.findall(r'([a-zA-Z0-9_:-]+)\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']*)["\']', m.group(1)))
            name = attrs.get("name") or attrs.get("property")
            if name and any(x in name.lower() for x in ["citation_", "dc.", "prism.", "og:title", "description"]):
                metas.setdefault(name, []).append(attrs.get("content", ""))
        p_entry["meta_tags"] = metas
        xplore_m = re.search(r"xplGlobal\.document\.metadata\s*=\s*(\{.*?\});", html, re.S)
        if xplore_m:
            try:
                xm = json.loads(xplore_m.group(1))
                p_entry["xplore_metadata"] = {
                    k: xm.get(k) for k in [
                        "title", "publicationTitle", "publicationDate", "onlineDate",
                        "publicationYear", "conferenceDate", "conferenceLocation",
                        "doi", "isEarlyAccess", "volume", "issue", "startPage", "endPage",
                        "contentType", "publicationNumber", "html_flag", "dateOfInsertion",
                        "authors", "pubLink", "articleNumber"
                    ] if k in xm
                }
            except Exception as ex:
                p_entry["xplore_metadata_err"] = str(ex)
        # Also snippet of body text if not xplore
        if not xplore_m:
            txt = unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", html))
            txt = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", txt).strip()
            p_entry["text_head"] = txt[:1500]
    out["doi_publisher"][rid] = p_entry

# arXiv checks for C08
arxiv_abs = fetch("https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.20860")
arxiv_api = fetch("https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=2412.20860")
out["arxiv"]["abs"] = {
    "url": arxiv_abs["url"],
    "final_url": arxiv_abs["final_url"],
    "accessed_at": arxiv_abs["accessed_at"],
    "status": arxiv_abs["status"],
    "error": arxiv_abs["error"],
    "body_excerpt": re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", arxiv_abs["body"])).strip()[:3000] if arxiv_abs["body"] else None,
    "meta_tags": {
        m.group(1): m.group(2)
        for m in re.finditer(r'<meta\s+name="([^"]+)"\s+content="([^"]*)"', arxiv_abs["body"] or "")
    }
}
out["arxiv"]["api"] = {
    "url": arxiv_api["url"],
    "final_url": arxiv_api["final_url"],
    "accessed_at": arxiv_api["accessed_at"],
    "status": arxiv_api["status"],
    "error": arxiv_api["error"],
    "body": arxiv_api["body"][:4000] if arxiv_api["body"] else None,
}

out_path = "/Users/joker/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/85d95df5-1966-4e95-bfea-59213d336305/scratch/net_check.json"
import pathlib
pathlib.Path(out_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path(out_path).write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
print("WROTE:", out_path)
for rid, _ in DOIS:
    cr = out["crossref"][rid]
    pub = out["doi_publisher"][rid]
    print(rid, "| CR:", cr["status"], cr.get("error"), "| PUB:", pub["status"], pub.get("final_url"), pub.get("error"))
print("arXiv abs:", out["arxiv"]["abs"]["status"], "api:", out["arxiv"]["api"]["status"])
PY

import json, pathlib

SCRATCH = pathlib.Path("/Users/joker/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/85d95df5-1966-4e95-bfea-59213d336305/scratch")
d = json.loads((SCRATCH / "identity_dates_01_compact.json").read_text())

c14_lines = pathlib.Path("screening_46/text/C14.txt").read_bytes().replace(b"\x00", b"").decode("utf-8").splitlines()
print("C14 L1-7:", c14_lines[:7])
print("C14 L105-111:", c14_lines[104:111])

for s in d["sources"]:
    if s["source_id"] == "C03_LOCAL_TXT":
        s["locator"] = "lines 3-13 (p. 1), 47 (p. 2), 97 (p. 3), 482 (p. 11); pdfinfo"
    elif s["source_id"] == "C14_LOCAL_TXT":
        s["locator"] = "lines 3-6, 106-110 (PDF page 1; NUL-stripped); pdfinfo"
    elif s["source_id"] == "C19_LOCAL_TXT":
        s["locator"] = "lines 3-6, 102-106 (p. 1), 1548 (p. 15); pdfinfo"

compact = json.dumps(d, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
(SCRATCH / "identity_dates_01_compact.json").write_text(compact)
print("Updated compact len:", len(compact))
PY
